title: observability: token/kv logging + metrics dashboard + alert tuning
author: Amit Varma
description: Motivation: customers running large-context workloads report intermittent cost spikes and opaque KV cache behavior. This PR surfaces token-level KV metrics and structured logging, adds a consolidated dashboard for token/kv cost+latency, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise. Scope: 1) structured token/kv logs emitted at request completion (includes request_id, model, route, tokens_generated, kv_hits, kv_misses, latency_ms, cost_units); 2) new Prometheus metrics for token-level cost and KV-cache hits/misses + histograms for per-request token latency; 3) Grafana dashboard (token_kv_overview) that combines token cost, latency, KV hit-rate, and top offending routes; 4) alert tuning: adjust token-cost and KV-cache-miss alerts (incorporate rate-of-change and p95 latency windows) and add suppression during rolling model rollouts; 5) docs and runbook updates. Changeset is intentionally small and additive; logging uses structured JSON and feature-flagged to off by default for clients on older telemetry pipelines.

b7c8d9e: perf(observability): batch metrics export and minimize label cardinality for route/model
f0e1d2c: ui(dashboards): add token_kv_overview dashboard + panels and templating vars
e3f4a5b: infra(alerts): tune rules for token-cost and kv-miss with p95 windows and cooldowns

dashboards/grafana/token_kv_overview.json - new dashboard: panels for token cost, kv hit-rate, per-route p50/p95 latency, top 10 routes by cost

release_notes: Added token-level KV logging and metrics, a new Grafana dashboard (token_kv_overview), and tuned alerts for token cost and KV cache misses. Feature is behind feature-flag; telemetry teams should enable flag and run validation before enabling in production.
notes: Feature-flag default: off for customers using legacy telemetry pipeline. Telemetry team to schedule gradual rollout in staging during next maintenance window. Observability and SRE to monitor for alert noise for 72 hours after rollout.
